<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">What are we ?</h2><a id="user-content-what-are-we-" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: What are we ?" href="#what-are-we-"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">A dev-first open source autonomous AI agent framework enabling developers to build, manage & run useful autonomous agents. You can run concurrent agents seamlessly, extend agent capabilities with tools. The agents efficiently perform a variety of tasks and continually improve their performance with each subsequent run.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">💡 Features</h3><a id="user-content--features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 💡 Features" href="#-features"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><b>Provision, Spawn & Deploy Autonomous AI Agents</b> - Create production-ready & scalable autonomous agents.</li>
<li><b>Extend Agent Capabilities with Toolkits</b> - Add Toolkits from our marketplace to your agent workflows.</li>
<li><b>Graphical User Interface</b> - Access your agents through a graphical user interface.</li>
<li><b>Action Console</b> - Interact with agents by giving them input and permissions.</li>
<li><b>Multiple Vector DBs</b> - Connect to multiple Vector DBs to enhance your agent’s performance.</li>
<li><b>Performance Telemetry</b> - Get insights into your agent’s performance and optimize accordingly.</li>
<li><b>Optimized Token Usage</b> - Control token usage to manage costs effectively.</li>
<li><b>Agent Memory Storage</b> - Enable your agents to learn and adapt by storing their memory.</li>
<li><b>Models</b> - Custom fine tuned models for business specific usecases.</li>
<li><b>Workflows</b> - Automate tasks with ease using ReAct LLM's predefined steps.</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto">You can install superAGI using one of the following three approaches.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">☁️ SuperAGI cloud</h4><a id="user-content-️-superagi-cloud" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: ☁️ SuperAGI cloud" href="#️-superagi-cloud"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">To quickly start experimenting with agents without the hassle of setting up the system, try <a href="https://app.superagi.com/" rel="nofollow">Superagi Cloud</a></p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>
<p dir="auto">Visit <a href="https://app.superagi.com/" rel="nofollow">Superagi Cloud</a> and log in using your github account.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">In your account settings, go to "Model Providers" and add your API key.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">You're all set! Start running your agents effortlessly.</p>
